description:
A GitHub Desktop fork with advanced functionality and improvements.

An up-to-date fork of GitHub Desktop with additional features including multiple account support, integration with third-party Git providers, commit search, multiple stashes per branch, and more.
Upstream: GitHub Desktop 3.6.6-beta1 release notes
Changes and improvements:
- Added a new context menu option to "Duplicate Branch" in the branch list. This is useful for quickly starting work on an existing (local or remote) branch without having to switch to it first.
Fixes:
- [#259] When choosing a GitLab, Gitea, or Codeberg/Forgejo repository from your account in the "Clone a repository" dialog, and you have a large number of repositories, the app now correctly fetches the entire list. Thanks @cjohnsonoem!
